NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to confirm you are at the store when you check in or count the cash drawer.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Your location is used to confirm you are at the store when you check in.
NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to verify your face at check-in and to scan kiosk QR codes.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is only needed by the camera for face verification videos. No audio is kept.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo access lets you pick a profile picture or attach photos in chat.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID lets you sign in faster.
